answer: Farming becomes a ridge bet on surviving 105 epochs of grading, and every marble settlement recomputes the juniper schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 105 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
